say:1:1821430001:1.text: No, no... I'm out of onions, and there are barely any beans left. The soup's going to be too thin...
say:1:1821430001:1.source_cn: 完了完了，洋葱不够了，豆子也快用完了，这锅汤、汤会太稀的……

say:2:1821430002:1.text: He'll notice as soon as he tastes it. And when he does... he'll have my head!
say:2:1821430002:1.source_cn: 他一定会尝出来的，要是发火了怎么办！他一定会杀了我的！

say:3:1821430003:1.text: I'm running out of time... Where did everything go? There has to be something left...
say:3:1821430003:1.source_cn: 天哪，时间……时间不够了……怎么办，食材在哪……到底在哪……

choice_prompt:4:1821430003.text: I'm running out of time... Where did everything go? There has to be something left...
choice_prompt:4:1821430003.source_cn: 天哪，时间……时间不够了……怎么办，食材在哪……到底在哪……

say:5:1821430004:1.text: Sharu! Thank goodness! Help me look. Some beans rolled into the lower hold earlier, and there might still be an onion or two down there!
say:5:1821430004:1.source_cn: 山鲁！你来了！快，帮我找找，底舱应该还有些之前滚出去的...
say:5:1821430004:1.male: Sharu! Thank goodness! Help me look. Some beans rolled into the lower hold earlier, and there might still be an onion or two down there!
say:5:1821430004:1.female: Sharu! Thank goodness! Help me look. Some beans rolled into the lower hold earlier, and there might still be an onion or two down there!

say:6:1821430005:1.text: Please, just find me something I can put in the soup. If I don't finish it, he'll kill me!
say:6:1821430005:1.source_cn: 求你了，必须找点什么加进去，不然、不然我没法和他交差！

choice:7:1:2.text: Who are you afraid of? The captain? The first mate?
